summary: Suppress near-duplicate alerts on POST /api/alerts: if an active alert with the same Title (case-insensitive) and Severity was created within a configurable window (default 15 min), return 200 OK with the existing alert and header X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true instead of creating a new row; genuinely new alerts still return 201 Created.
adjacent_dependencies: AlertService.API/Program.cs (existing IConfiguration.GetValue<T> convention to follow, unaffected)
constraints: Match on Title case-insensitive + exact Severity; must not suppress across different severities
Only an active (IsActive == true) prior alert can suppress; inactive prior alerts must not suppress
Suppression window in minutes must be read from appsettings.json, not hardcoded; default 15
Use TimeProvider (already injected) for now/cutoff computation, not DateTime.UtcNow
No IOptions<T> pattern exists in repo; follow existing direct IConfiguration.GetValue<T> convention from Program.cs
No existing mechanism for a service method to signal a secondary flag (duplicate) back to the controller; requires a minimal new wrapper - implementation-time decision
AlertResponse and DTOs stay unchanged; no schema/migration change needed
coverage_goals: behavior coverage: suppress within window (same title/severity, active) -> 200 + header, no new row; different severity -> 201; window expired -> 201; prior alert inactive -> 201; case-insensitive title match -> suppressed
unresolved_questions: Exact shape of the duplicate-signal returned from AlertManagementService.CreateAsync to AlertsController.Create (e.g. result wrapper vs tuple) - left to /implement-story
Exact config key name for the suppression window (e.g. Alerts:DuplicateSuppressionWindowMinutes) - left to /implement-story, default value must be 15
